subject: POC onramp: proposed success metrics, milestones, and weekly pulse
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@heliocart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC onramp: proposed success metrics, milestones, and weekly pulse

Hi Aisha —

Great to meet earlier. Capturing the key items we discussed and a compact POC plan so we can align your team and ours. High-level ask: confirm these success criteria and who on your side will be the day-to-day owner for each area (integration, data, availability). Once confirmed I’ll schedule the sprint-zero kickoff and weekly 30-min pulses.

POC objective (2 weeks): validate HelioCart cart-inference use case at 95th-percentile latency <= 120ms and less than 20% cost uplift vs baseline.

Proposed success criteria (attached workbook for details):
- Functional: model returns item suggestions with precision@5 >= 0.45 on your test prompts (we'll run your eval set).
- Latency: 95th <= 120ms (p50 target 40-60ms).
- Reliability: <1% error rate over a 24h soak.
- Ops: infra/network tests pass (egress rules validated, reqs in network doc).

Milestones / schedule (compact):
1) Sprint-zero (Day 0–2): access, network checklist, sample data ingestion, baseline run. Owner: HelioCart Eng Ops.
2) Integration + smoke (Day 3–5): SDK integration, tokenization checks, sample inference. Owner: Redwood SE.
3) Eval run (Day 6–10): run full eval set, collect metrics, quality review. Owner: HelioCart Data Lead + Redwood ML eng.
4) Readout + decision (Day 11–14): joint decision on next steps. Owner: Aisha / Connor.

Weekly pulse: 30-min sync every Tue at 10:00 PT (first suggested: Oct 5). Agenda: blockers, metric run-rate, next actions.

Immediate asks for your team: confirm owners for Integration and Data (names + emails), and grant temporary token for sample ingestion (we'll provide least-privilege creds).

Attachments: HelioCart_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, network-requirements-brief.pdf

Thanks — happy to tighten timelines if you prefer a longer window.

-Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@heliocart.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Reed <devon@heliocart.com>, HelioCart Eng Ops <engops@heliocart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:16:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed success metrics, milestones, and weekly pulse

Thanks Connor — this is very clear and appreciated. Quick responses inline and ownership: 

- Owners: Integration & infra — Devon Reed (devon@heliocart.com). Data lead — Priya Shah (priya.shah@heliocart.com) (cc'd on a separate thread for data access).
- Timeline: the two-week compact works if we start sprint-zero next Monday (Oct 4). We do want to preserve an option to extend one week if we hit unexpected data prep blockers.
- Success criteria: precision@5 target looks reasonable; we'll share a cleaned eval set (anonymized) by EOD Wed.

Notes on network: our security team will need the network-reqs-brief reviewed; I'll loop them into the Oct 5 pulse if needed. 

Next step: please confirm we can get a least-privileged token and a sample ingestion endpoint by Oct 4 morning. Also confirm the calendar invite for Tue 10:00 PT starting Oct 5.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Product, HelioCart

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@heliocart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Devon Reed <devon@heliocart.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed success metrics, milestones, and weekly pulse

Thanks Aisha — confirming next steps and owners. Quick operational notes: 

- Token: we'll provision a scoped API key (read-only for ingestion + test inference) and share via your SSO-safe vault link (please confirm preferred secret store).
- Sample ingestion: we only need a 3–5k sample of anonymized items and ~200 conversational prompts for the eval. If you can deliver CSV + JSON mappings we're good.
- Kickoff: scheduling sprint-zero for Monday Oct 4 at 09:00 PT. I'll send calendar invites shortly.

Marissa/Stephanie — can you confirm Redwood leads for integration and the eval run? Marissa: SE to own the SDK integration and test run. Stephanie: ML-engineer to partner on the eval and quality scoring.

Thanks — Connor

Quick weekly pulse and action-owner nudge (first sync today at 10:00 PT):

Status snapshot:
- Sprint-zero: blocked -> awaiting HelioCart sample dataset + confirmation of secret store. (Aisha / Priya)
- SDK integration: Marissa has engineers ready for Oct 4–6 (in progress).
- Eval prep: Stephanie preparing scoring notebook; will need the anonymized eval by EOD Wed.
- Network/security: Devon to confirm that the network-reqs-brief is acceptable to security; if any changes, flag today.

This sync will be a working 30-min session — please come with any open blockers and ETA for items above. If we can't get the sample data by Wed we should push the eval window by one week.

Immediate asks (action owners):
- Aisha / Priya: upload anonymized eval set to the shared bucket and confirm secret store for the token (due Wed EOD).
- Devon: confirm network security comments or "no blockers" in the pulse.
- Marissa: share brief SDK runbook after your smoke tests (link in the shared drive).

If anyone prefers a different cadence, voice it in the sync — otherwise we'll keep Tue 10:00 PT weekly.

Thanks everyone — see you at 10.

-Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
